name: Diego Cadena Lau
headline: Supercharging finance through tech
about:
With over 15 years in finance, I've honed a versatile skill set across multiple industries. I've led high-impact financial strategies that improved profitability, streamlined operations, and delivered exceptional value. My journey, including working with a billion-dollar startup, has equipped me with a deep understanding of strategic financial planning, reporting, compliance, and cross-functional team leadership.

I excel at integrating financial systems and leading data-driven strategies that align with broader business goals. Whether it's spearheading innovative financial models or fostering a culture of financial resilience, I approach each challenge with a blend of technical expertise and creativity.

As a forward-thinking finance executive, my aim is to contribute to transparent, efficient financial management that drives sustainable growth. I'm passionate about applying my strategic mindset and leadership skills to empower organizations to achieve their next milestones.
… more

experiences.description: - Head of Finance for Mexico and USA Freight Forwarding Business and responsible for Nowports Capital financial and regulatory affairs.

- I directed a team of 15 full-time employees with a scope in accounting and treasury for the Mexico Freight Forwarding business and the innovative Fintech, Nowports Capital from a financial and regulatory perspective.

- Served as Commercial Finance Head for Brazil and the Latin America Small Business vertical.

- I reached agreements from US$50K deals with startups to >US$100M deal with top banks and mining companies in Brazil optimizing profitability and getting to the customer’s budget, building awareness of the brand and pushing competition in the region.

- Responsible for US$1Bn OPEX allocation among USA, Canada and Latin America.

- Worked along Country and Vertical Managing Directors to optimize resources allocations, setting and achieving budget compliance.

- Oversaw comprehensive financial reporting and analysis for operations in Mexico and an US-based technology development hub, ensuring exceptional accuracy and strategic insight into business performance. Built and presented Local Leadership decks to Regional CFO and CEO.

- Directed a skilled team of 3 data scientists, leveraging advanced analytics to uncover key business insights such as optimization of top-selling SKUs, shipping routes, marketing campaigns, and identification of most profitable categories and sellers.

- Responsible of 3 business units financial metrics working directly with Financial Leaders in the local and global team in St. Louis, MO.

- Built and presented business performance decks with the CFO and CEO of the office in Mexico and USA.

- Responsible of the P&L for Private and International Business, working directly with the New York team office.

- Led a successfull intrapreneurial project developing and getting to market a Personal Accidents Insurance in a joint-venture with top retailers in Mexico.
